Identified as this saint because: Commons describes it as 'Silouan the Athonite / Силуан Афонский' and files it under Category:Icons of Saint Silouan the Athonite. It is the Russian monk of St Panteleimon on Athos, in the world Simeon Ivanovich Antonov (1866-1938) - the folder's saint - and not Silvanus/Silouan of the Seventy, who is kept on 30 July and appears in the Russian Lives series only in the company of Silas and Crescens. Commons describes it: Silouan the Athonite Силуан Афонский
